Give it your best!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 25 (Formerly, [[Easy Mode|Easy]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Grave Digger''' is the final boss for [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode and one of the [[Challenge Trials]] mini-bosses. It also appeared in [[The Classic Event]]. The '''Grave Digger''' has [[Stun Immunity]], reducing the effectiveness of the stun from stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]], while also preventing it from being knocked back. As it is a [[Boss]] enemy, it is also immune to being frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], confused by the [[Jester]], damaged from the [[Nuke]]'s fallout and slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]]. It has very high health compared to anything that spawns before, but to compensate, it moves very slowly. In addition, it can stun towers and damage units by performing its ''Stomp'' or ''Shovel'' abilities, both having different stun duration and damage values. It can also perform its ''Summon'' ability which spawns multiple enemies. These enemies all have different odds of spawning and start a delay before another enemy be spawned. The '''Grave Digger''' was replaced by the [[Toilet Boss]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Grave Digger''' is a hulking humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a desaturated light green skin color and has grey legs. It wears a ragged grey cloak with a hood, sleeves and coattails, which has white accents and patches of cloth sewn on. It has tan bandages wrapped on its legs and lower arms, which have green fluid stains on them. It wears black boots with brown laces, white pauldrons with grey edges, and two brown belts with white buckles, with one on the torso and one on the waist. It has a light grey tombstone with a crown shape at the top chained to its back. It has an angry face with glowing red eyes, sharp teeth and stitches at the sides of its mouth. It wields a shovel with a dark brown wooden handle and a light grey metal spade and end. For its ''Summon'' ability, it will point its shovel skyward, where lightning will then continuously strike on it until the ability ends. For its ''Stomp'' ability, it stomps its right foot, creating a white shockwave and a small crater in the ground. For its ''Shovel'' ability, it digs its shovel into the ground, and brings it back up, which flings cubes of brown dirt at towers. It has a death animation where it will place its shovel on the ground to act like a cane, before trembling, dropping the shovel and falling to its knees and hands. It then outstretches its right hand before falling face first onto the ground. Due to a bug, the '''Grave Digger's''' corpse despawns before the death animation finishes, and can only fully be viewed with [[Time Scale]] set to a higher setting. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Grave Digger''' was a very large humanoid with a desaturated green skin color. It wore a ragged black cloak with a cape, hood and sleeves and had granite dark green legs. It had a glowing red eyes, had white bandages wrapped around its arms and legs and wore grey diamond plate boots. It had a light grey tombstone chained to its back and had brown belts with grey buckles on its torso. It wielded a large shovel with a brown wooden handle and a grey metal spade and cap. For its ''Summon'' ability, it will dig its shovel into the ground repeatedly. For its ''Stomp'' ability, it would stomp its right foot into the ground, creating a white shockwave. On death, it slowly fell on its back whilst dropping its shovel and emitting a low groaning sound. }} ==Enemies Spawned== *[[Normal]] **15% chance of being spawned. **0.05 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. *[[Speedy]] **15% chance of being spawned. **0.05 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. *[[Slow]] **14% chance of being spawned. **0.1 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. *[[Skeleton]] **14% chance of being spawned. **0.1 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. *[[Bolt]] **14% chance of being spawned. **0.2 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. *[[Normal Boss]] **14% chance of being spawned. **0.2 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. *[[Hazmat]] **14% chance of being spawned. **0.3 second delay before another enemy can be spawned. ==Strategy== *Multiple early-game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Hunter]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Cowboy]] should be enough to defeat the '''Grave Digger'''. **High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]] can also be used, though they can be quite expensive for [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode. ***The [[Commander]], [[Medic]] and [[DJ Booth]] should be used to support these towers. ***Be aware that the '''Grave Digger''' can spawn multiple enemies at once. This means that if the [[Accelerator]] locks onto the '''Grave Digger''', you may need to place other towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Turret]] to deal with the summoned enemies. *[[Rocketeer]]s, [[Demoman|Demomen]] and [[Mortar]]s can be helpful against this boss as they are able to kill the enemies summoned from the ''Summon'' ability fairly well. *Towers near the path are vulnerable to the ''Stomp'' and ''Shovel'' abilities. Placing towers away from the path can help avoid some of them getting stunned. **Towers with [[Stun Immunity]], like the [[Ranger]], [[Brawler]] or [[Gatling Gun]] can be used as they cannot be stunned. ***The [[Medic]] can also be used to make towers which are not normally immune to stuns immune to them. *If you want to kill the '''Grave Digger''' quickly, instant damage methods such as airdropping [[Riot Guard]]s or multiple Bear Traps from [[Trapper]] can be effective. **Using the [[Nuke]] consumable can greatly wound the '''Grave Digger''' by reducing it to 10,000 health, though this is not recommended as the '''Grave Digger''' is fairly weak and the consumable could be used for bigger threats. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} GraveDigger2.png|First version (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} GraveDiggerWalk.gif|Current version, current walk animation (25 September 2024 – Present) GraveDiggerSummon.gif|Current version, current ''Summon'' animation (25 September 2024 – Present) GraveDiggerStomp.gif|Current version, current ''Stomp'' animation (25 September 2024 – Present) GraveDiggerDig.gif|Current version, current ''Shovel'' animation (25 September 2024 – Present) GraveDiggerDeathAnimation.gif|Current version, current death animation (25 September 2024 – Present) LegacyGraveDiggerWalk.gif|First version, walk animation (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) LegacyGraveDiggerDig.gif|First version, ''Summon'' animation (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) LegacyGraveDiggerStomp.gif|First version, ''Stomp'' animation (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) LegacyGraveDiggerDeathAnimation.gif|First version, death animation (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDigger.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.33Thumbnail.png|'''Grave Digger''' on the game thumbnail. IndexGraveDigger.png|'''Grave Digger''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *There is a Roblox bundle based on the '''Grave Digger''', namely the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/996/Grave-Digger Grave Digger] bundle. **Weirdly, the bundle used to call the '''Grave Digger''' a goblin in its name, despite it not being a goblin in-game. **The individual items of the bundle, such as the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/11768976933/Grave-Digger-Goblin-Torso Grave Digger Goblin - Torso], still call it a goblin. *The '''Grave Digger's''' final wave music is a remixed version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vwvwXt5cnS4 Cursed Abbey]. **Coincidentally, the [[Raider Boss]] also used the same song, just not remixed. *According to [[1x1x1x1]] in [[Classic Forest Camp]], the '''Grave Digger''' is its camping buddy. *The animation played when summoning is a reference to the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Eureka_Effect Eureka Effect's] teleport ability from Team Fortress 2. *The '''Grave Digger''' loves tacos, as revealed through the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]][[File:GraveDiggerTacoLover.png|280px]]. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''24 February 2024''' -
